title: MaxGroup
description: MAXGEN 2.0 -- one MaxGroup document is one historical group (an emigrant company, a regiment, a congregation, a household followed across documents) holding only the group's own facts, once, and no member list, because each membership is a claim on the person with group_id.

group_id.description: The group's permanent id: a random UUID created once by the writer (an import_file, resolve_conflict or build_tree task, R-24); merges and splits are made only by analysis (R-28).

is_living_flag.description: Living A for the group file itself: true when its period or its names (such as 'the Mossbury household') touch someone who may be alive; when unsure, true; never worked out from members; a floor that only rises; true requires tier2-private.

redistribution_license.description: The licence under which this group document may be shared; must be tier2-private when is_living_flag is true.

group_kind.description: What kind of historical group this is (there is no kind for a research cluster of friends, associates and neighbours: those stay as MaxTask results); when no value fits, write other and give the words in group_kind_as_written.

group_kind_as_written.description: The source's or program's own words for the kind of group.

group_kind_uri.description: The address of the kind in a published vocabulary of group types, when there is one.

name_assertions.description: The names the group was known by, each a claim with its own evidence; at least one is required.

fact_assertions.description: The group's own dated facts (organized, departed, arrived ...), each stored once here with its own evidence and never copied onto members; a member's page shows those inside the membership period at read time.

parent_group_assertions.description: Larger groups this group belonged to during a period (a company inside a regiment), each a claim with its own evidence.

observed_in.description: The documents that describe the group, including ones that name none of its members.

media_refs.description: Photographs and other files of the group, pointed at by fingerprint on the record that holds each file (each file is described once, on the record that captured it).

name_claim.description: One name the group was known by, from one piece of evidence.

name_as_written.description: The group's name exactly as the evidence gives it.

lang.description: The language of the name (a BCP 47 tag such as en or de).

name_type.description: What kind of name this is (leader_name for a company known by its captain's name); when no value fits, write other and give the words in name_type_as_written.

name_type_as_written.description: The source's own words for the kind of name.

date.description: The period in which the group carried this name.

fact_claim.description: One fact about the group itself (it departed on a day, it was mustered at a place), from one piece of evidence; a person-level claim for the same event needs basis conclusion.

fact_type.description: What happened to the group or what is known of it (existence: the group is shown to have existed); when no value fits, write other and give the words in fact_type_as_written.

fact_type_as_written.description: The source's own words for the fact.

date.description: When the fact happened, or the period it covers.

place.description: Where the fact happened, as written in the evidence.

place_role_as_written.description: The source's own words for the place's part in the fact (departed from, arrived at, camped near).

occurrence_id.description: The MaxEvent occasion this fact is about; for basis document it must equal the cited same-occasion entry's occurrence (the helper fills it when absent) and be absent when the entry is used indirectly; other rules as in spec 5.1.

parent_group_claim.description: One larger group this group belonged to during a period (a company inside a regiment), from one piece of evidence.

group_id.description: The larger MaxGroup, written by the writer of this claim; it must exist and be active when written (followed through merge redirects, Appendix C).

date.description: The period in which this group was part of the larger one.

observed_in_item.description: One document that describes the group, which may name none of its members.

record_id.description: The MaxRecord that describes the group; it must exist and be active when written (followed through merge redirects, Appendix C).

record_event_ref.description: The event entry on that record that concerns the group, looked up on that record only (labels are never redirected).

note.description: What the document shows about the group, in plain words.
